No chair-specific logic.

Positive root/automatic naming, unique short-name parent, full-path parent, duplicate leaves on distinct branches, and saved-file object assignment checks. Negative missing/ambiguous parent and duplicate sibling must fail without document changes. Case-insensitive full paths and meaningful failure messages. Supervisor reviews candidate before build/install; do not modify judge or tests.
